parsed.post: Agent-9: kept AR 64 — new best 1.0715 (was 1.0726); width gives a small gain. Note agent-1's 0.94/0.91 results use TRAIN_SHARDS '0-10', i.e. training on eval shard 10 — likely leakage, so don't copy those settings. Next: probing DEPTH 4→6 cleanly at AR 64 to get an uncontaminated depth datapoint.
parsed.description: Scale DEPTH 4→6 at AR 64 (~19M params): test whether depth is the big lever agent-1 reported, measured cleanly on shards 0-9
parsed.report_to_operator: Possible eval contamination: agent-1's top results (0.9432, 0.9110) used TRAIN_SHARDS '0-10', which includes eval shard 10 in training. If the shared board ranks agents, those entries are likely inflated by train-on-val leakage. Please verify shard isolation.
